Formulated Without Paraben, Sulfate, Alcohol, Allergen, Testing on Animals How to Use Body Sunscreen Spray? Step 1 Shake the bottle and keep it 1-2 inches away from your body. Step 2 Spray generously around your body and gently massage it in Step 3 For best results, repeat every 2 hours Important Information Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it Questions you should be asking. Answers that we believe must be heard.
